name: TNF receptor superfamily member 14

function.text: TNFRSF14 encodes tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 14. Annotated molecular activities include receptor ligand activity and tumor necrosis factor receptor activity. It participates in immune response and T cell costimulation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Pediatric-type follicular lymphoma; Primary cutaneous follicle center lymphoma; BCL2-rearrangement-negative, CD23-positive follicle center lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: TNFRSF14 encodes tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 14. Based in part on similarity, it is a receptor for four distinct ligands: The TNF superfamily members TNFSF14/LIGHT and homotrimeric LTA/lymphotoxin-alpha and the immunoglobulin superfamily members BTLA and CD160, altogether defining a complex stimulatory and inhibitory signaling network. It signals via the TRAF2-TRAF3 E3 ligase pathway to promote immune cell survival and differentiation. It participates in bidirectional cell-cell contact signaling between antigen presenting cells and lymphocytes.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TNFRSF14 have been reported in pediatric-type follicular lymphoma, primary cutaneous follicle center lymphoma, and BCL2-rearrangement-negative, CD23-positive follicle center lymphoma.
